## Analysis

The 17-element seed is sum-dominant: 59 sums versus 55 differences, but its normalized growth rates yield only \(C=1.059793\), far below the 1.144887 reference. Thus mere sum-dominance is insufficient; the search must improve the logarithmic ratio, potentially by changing cardinality rather than only maximizing \(|A+A|-|A-A|\). With only one evaluated run, no mutation strategy or larger construction has been refuted. Exact enumeration is cheap at \(n\le512\), so the remaining runtime should be spent on objective-directed search.

## Next

Starting from the seed, run simulated annealing over distinct normalized sets with `n_choices=[16,17,18,19,20,24,32]`, `restarts=64`, `steps_per_restart=20000`, and mutations consisting of one-element replacement, ±1/±2 shifts, insertion, and deletion; score every candidate by exact \(C(A)\), retain the global best, and stop at `time_limit=170` seconds.
